request.description: Creates the application (MSME cases start as a proprietorship; the business is named after its owner once the PAN is verified) or updates the open one: rupees → paise, years → months, the city before the comma located through the catalog. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.
